Inspect actual relevant inputs before making requirements; do not invent product facts or add a graph adapter/service.

Deliver IntentSpec with explicit goal, actor/trigger, in-scope behavior, non-goals, assumptions and unknowns, constraints, acceptance criteria, evidence references and affected repo obligations. Preserve 404 as non-retryable. Bind every claim to actual S02/S03 context and the exact candidate/fixture identity. Capture useful partial findings and mark unresolved ones PARTIAL/UNVERIFIED; critical missing evidence blocks only dependent decisions. Do not treat status in_review or producer prose as DONE/PASS.

This S04 is definition/decomposition only:
- Do not implement or modify any repository source, test, Skill/Core/Control, ProductKB, WorkspaceKnowledge, package, repo registration, or production artifact.
- Do not create a new agent, adapter, paper gate, or parallel workflow.
- Do not dispatch S05 or the supplemental positive case from this issue.
- Leave the issue in_review; Human DONE is not simulated.

Concurrency/resource controls (mandatory due the recorded S03 finding):
- One S04 parent Scenario at a time, with at most two ACTIVE Swarm runs including the parent; queued runs count. Only one child at a time.
- Run all applicable design/plan Reviewer work first, wait for its actual terminal result, then run Verifier; do not parallelize Reviewer and Verifier. Fan in each actual terminal result before any next dispatch.
- No next-stage dispatch until current S04 parent/children are terminal and the evidence fan-in is recorded. Do not cancel in-flight work or retry uncertain dispatch.
- Maximum eight required children, two correction revisions, 45 minutes per Scenario and 20 minutes per child. Stop new dispatch at a bound and preserve actual run handles/outcomes.
- Keep total task process RSS below 8 GiB.
